units.source_text: 忽然想起：这些画不妨给藤壶母后一看。

en.t: It suddenly occurred to him that he might show these paintings to Empress Mother Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 便从其中选出不甚触目伤心者各一帖，准备送给她看。

en.t: So he chose one scroll each from among those that would not be too painful to look at, and prepared to send them for her to see.

units.source_text: 但选到分明写出须磨、明石各浦风物的图画时，

en.t: But when he came to the pictures that clearly depicted the scenery and life along the shores of Suma and Akashi,

units.source_text: 心中便浮现出明石姬家中的情景来，一时难于忘怀。

en.t: the scene at Lady Akashi's home rose up in his heart, and for a while he found it hard to forget.

units.source_text: 权中纳言闻知源氏内大臣正在搜集画幅，

en.t: When the Acting Middle Counselor heard that Genji, the Inner Minister, was collecting paintings,

units.source_text: 便更加聚精会神，把画轴、裱纸、带子等装潢得越发精美了。

en.t: he devoted himself to the task all the more, making the mounting of the scrolls, covers, cords, and other details even more exquisite.
